hints.title: Monotonicity of Crossing Feasibility
hints.text: If it is possible to cross on day d, it was also possible on any earlier day; this allows binary searching the threshold day.

hints.title: Verifying Connectivity with BFS
hints.text: On day d, place water on the grid for all cells flooded up to day d, and test if a path from the top row to bottom row exists.

hints.title: Multi-Source Level Exploration
hints.text: Start breadth exploration simultaneously from all unflooded cells along row 0 to test reachability of row row - 1.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: count of flooded cells (R * C)
complexity.notes: Binary search over day sequence verified via level-order BFS reachability.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating cell additions one-by-one with full connectivity checks takes O(N * R * C) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search tests at most log(20,000) ~ 15 days.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize monotonic predicate and verify connectivity efficiently.
